name: New York University Abu Dhabi
englishBachelors: All programmes. A full liberal arts and science curriculum across arts and humanities, engineering, science, social science and interdisciplinary majors, awarding an NYU degree.
note: A full NYU campus on Saadiyat Island, awarding the New York degree, with study-away semesters across NYU's global network. All aid for non-Emiratis is need-based and renewed at the same level each year, against a 2026-27 cost of attendance of USD 90,434; admission is very competitive, so confirm the need-blind question with admissions directly.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: One of six engineering majors, built on mathematics and the basic sciences, with invention and entrepreneurship in every stage of study.
programmes.ib: No programme-specific IB subjects published; the site asks for strong preparation in mathematics and the sciences, and engineering majors need calculus early.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to NYUAD, not to a major. Finalists attend an invitation-only Candidate Weekend with a short interview and extra assessments.

flagshipSource.title: NYUAD Mechanical Engineering major; graduates receive a Bachelor of Science

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: A computer science degree set inside a liberal arts programme; it needs at least one semester of calculus.
programmes.ib: No programme-specific IB subjects published; maths preparation (algebra, pre-calculus or calculus) is encouraged before you enrol.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to NYUAD, not to a major. Finalists attend an invitation-only Candidate Weekend with a short interview and extra assessments.

programmes.name: Social Research and Public Policy
programmes.about: Economics, political science, sociology and research methods applied to problems such as migration, inequality and environmental change.
programmes.ib: No programme-specific IB subjects published; the major needs at least one semester of calculus.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to NYUAD, not to a major. Finalists attend an invitation-only Candidate Weekend with a short interview and extra assessments.

summary: Liberal-arts NYU campus on Saadiyat Island: 26 majors in arts, engineering, science and social science, taught in English, with 15 global study sites.

ib.text: No IB points or subject minimum is published; it asks for transcripts and predicted scores through your school. Calculus is strongly advised for maths-heavy majors. English test needed unless 3 years in English.

apply.via: Common Application; choose NYU, then Abu Dhabi campus

dates.label: CSS Profile aid deadline, Regular Decision

faculties.name: Arts and Humanities
faculties.line: Majors include Art and Art History, Film and New Media, History, Literature, Music, Philosophy and Theater. Only algebra needed.

faculties.name: Engineering
faculties.line: Six majors: General, Bio, Civil, Computer, Electrical and Mechanical Engineering. Calculus is needed early.

faculties.name: Science
faculties.line: Majors include Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.

faculties.name: Social Science
faculties.line: Majors include Business, Organizations and Society, Economics, Political Science and Social Research and Public Policy.

notes: Binding Early Decision: if admitted, you withdraw other applications. NYUAD publishes its dates without a year, so 2026-27 years are expected; its Candidate Weekend page confirms the 2026-27 cycle.
Finalists are invited to Candidate Weekend (Dec 2026, Feb and Mar 2027); NYUAD covers travel and accommodation. An invitation does not guarantee admission.
Application also needs STARS, an NYUAD Applicant Profile, one recommendation and a USD 85 fee (waivers available). NYU is test-optional through 2027-28.
English test (taken within two years) is required unless English was the only language of instruction for three years; NYUAD may still ask for one.

Estimated 2026-27 cost of attendance USD 90,434, with tuition USD 68,574. Non-Emirati aid is need-based via the CSS Profile and normally renewed at the same level; Emirati citizens receive a government scholarship.
Gaps: no IB points or subject minimum, and no programme-specific IB requirements, are published.
